items: [Reading] quoted fields: commas inside are literal and `""` is one quote
[Reading] the empty line is one empty field; a trailing comma adds an empty field
[Reading] a quote inside an unquoted field, or text after a closing quote, returns `None`
[Writing] a field is quoted if and only if it has a comma, a quote, or a leading or trailing space
[Writing] quotes inside a quoted field are doubled
[Writing] writing then reading returns the original fields
